purpose: Finite authoring instructions for the nine manifest entries; these records are not an executable expression language or runtime loader.

application.grouping: Serialized Node3D groups are source provenance. Flatten static mesh transforms. Retain actual camera attachments and motion-target relationships, without per-entity Node/Object wrappers.
application.hidden_wrapper_siblings: Resolved records preserve every hidden Cube/Plane/Sphere/Deformer. Do not accidentally publish them as visible geometry; source records remain available for explicit visibility edits.
application.shared_assets: Resolve identical mesh_asset.path + gltf_mesh to one mesh resource. Keep source morph targets. Per-instance morph weights and overrides must not mutate shared asset data.
application.resource_references: Serialized ExtResource IDs are local to their file; SubResource IDs are local to their file. Resolved values qualify paths and subresource identities. Do not execute script properties retained in serialized provenance.
application.startup_vs_authored: Resolved rows describe authored pre-_ready state. Apply the following startup and motion recipes separately; --still preserves authored poses.

capture.ordering: Apply pose before rendering; read image only after that rendered frame completes.
capture.failure: Log save result and path; do not claim capture success on error.

startup.visible: light_mode == all OR lowercase(light name) == light_mode

startup.morph_state: Instance-owned weights; original script duplicated ArrayMesh before changing weight 0.

renderer_modes.switch: Reset nrd_dlss_sr and scale on selection. Selecting a non-raw mode does not automatically resume previously paused motion.
renderer_modes.sr: Only NRD modes toggle ordinary DLSS SR. Reconfigure viewport at scale 1.0.
renderer_modes.resolution: Raw PT stays native. Other modes toggle scale 1.0/0.67; use FSR2 when neither RR nor ordinary DLSS SR is selected.

camera_controls.C: Switch active pose on the same viewport
camera_controls.mouse: RMB: global Y rotation -relative.x * 0.003, local X rotation -relative.y * 0.003
camera_controls.movement: WASD/QE, unnormalized local vector, active_camera.basis * direction * delta * 6.0

commands.1..5: Select renderer mode in listed order
commands.Space: Toggle animate; elapsed time still advances
commands.L: Remove first remaining light and its render membership
commands.R: Reverse remaining lights and republish their order
commands.B: Toggle shadow_enabled for every remaining light
commands.Delete: Delete deformer mesh target if present
commands.Z: If window width is 1280 set 1024x640, otherwise 1280x720

gallery_family.automatic_capture: Once elapsed >= delay, capture after draw, log measured GPU and video/texture/buffer memory, then quit.

shadow_matrix.multimesh: Retain each serialized 24-float two-instance buffer verbatim: three row-major vec4 rows per instance, distinct from Transform3D column-vector serialization.

ddgi.attachment_contract: Keep the exact serialized camera-relative parent transforms, layers=2 and gi_mode=0 overrides, and reflective material. They follow every camera pose including DDGI trajectory.

camera_controls.mouse: screen_relative changes Euler yaw/pitch; assign Basis.from_euler
camera_controls.movement: Normalize WASD/arrows/QE vector; velocity += 6.0 * delta * basis * motion; velocity *= 0.85; position += velocity

sequence.start: At setup snapshot camera global pose and prior animate/input/process flags; disable cube animation and free camera input/process before the delay.
sequence.frame_counts: CLI motion_frames replaces both 8-frame phases; hold/recovery remain 40 each. Default total is 96 rendered frames.
sequence.forward_return: initial.origin - normalize(initial.basis.z) * distance_m * amount; initial basis unchanged
sequence.rotation: Basis(world_up, radians(24.0 * amount)) * initial.basis; initial origin unchanged
sequence.capture: Apply each pose before its post-draw await; capture every rendered frame as <basename>-000.png through -095.png by default. Log phase, sequence/frame IDs, timestamps, delta, pose and actual DDGI/render settings.
sequence.finish: Restore exact initial pose and prior animation/camera flags; log completion and quit.

ddgi.single_capture: Without a motion sequence, capture once after elapsed >= delay and frame_post_draw; log pose/settings and quit.

startup.morph_state: Instance-owned weights; preserve imported Stretch target

microgeometry.camera_controls: Without orbit use gallery RMB/WASD/QE movement; one viewport.

commands.Space: Toggle object/morph motion; elapsed time advances
commands.G: Increment rt_error_index modulo 3 then assign value
commands.H: Increment offscreen_multiplier_index modulo 3 then assign value

unload_reload.unload: Clear MultiMesh, remove the three instances and their render membership, release their mesh references. Keep saved authored transforms and material configuration.
unload_reload.reload: Reload the shared dragon asset with replace semantics. Recreate three instances at saved authored transforms, restore moving masked override and current primary emissive flag; rebuild the same three-element MultiMesh. No PackedScene or Node creation in native implementation.
unload_reload.failure: Missing asset is explicit failure; do not claim loaded state or publish partial instances.

mesh_roundtrip.operation: Save primary shared mesh and microgeometry, reload as ArrayMesh with replace semantics, assign to primary, rebuild MultiMesh using that mesh; moving/offscreen keep their current imported mesh.
mesh_roundtrip.existing_output: Do not use or retain the current untracked native_roundtrip.res as a required input.

microgeometry.freeze_after: One-shot when enabled and elapsed >= freeze_after, before motion/capture processing.
microgeometry.automatic_capture: After elapsed >= delay capture once after draw and quit.

stress.authoring: Use the 10000 retained serialized instance transforms exactly. There is no runtime population-generation recipe in the current source. Flatten each imported root and its single mesh into one native record while preserving the composed transform.

normalization.placement: Exact origin values are retained per instance; do not rederive from rounded AABBs or replace owner edits with a fresh grid.

stress.setup: Resolve two imported mesh assets, check each has nonempty levels/pages, count 5000+5000 native instances and two shared resources. Enable frame timing only after setup; no imported PackedScene inspection instantiation in the native path.
stress.inspect_import: Report native asset metadata and exit without frame timing.

capture.ordering: Wait requested delay after setup, then post-draw capture
